hooks: Tired of wondering what to make with random ingredients tonight?
Staring at a half-empty fridge with no idea what to cook?
Ever throw away forgotten groceries because you lacked recipe ideas?
hook_card_prompt: Bold title card with text 'PantryPal' in crisp clean typography over a modern kitchen aesthetic background

claims.text: People waste food and time because they do not know what to cook with what they already have.
